chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad, from Ṣāliḥ ibn Mazyad, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Abū al-Ṣabbāḥ, from Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام), who said:

My mother was sitting by a wall when the wall cracked, and we heard a severe crashing sound. So she gestured with her hand and said: ‘No, by the right of al-Muṣṭafā صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, Allah has not permitted you to fall.’ So it remained suspended in the air until she passed by it, then my father gave one hundred dīnārs in charity on her behalf.

Abū al-Ṣabbāḥ said: Abū ʿAbd Allāh (عليه السلام) once mentioned his grandmother, the mother of his father, and said: ‘She was a truthful woman; no woman like her was found among the family of al-Ḥasan.’
Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad, similarly.

key_terms.أَذِنَ: Granted permission; here it refers to Allah not permitting the wall to fall.
key_terms.السُّقُوطِ: Falling down; the threatened collapse of the wall.
key_terms.الْمُصْطَفَى: A title of the Prophet Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, invoked here in an oath by his sanctified rank.
key_terms.تَصَدَّقَ: Gave in charity; referring to the father’s charitable donation on her behalf.
key_terms.دِينَارٍ: A gold coin; here the amount of one hundred dīnārs given as charity.
key_terms.صِدِّيقَةً: A highly truthful woman, marked by sincerity and truthfulness.
key_terms.مُعَلَّقًا: Suspended; describing the wall as remaining hanging in the air.

ai.seo_question: What does al-Kāfī narrate about the mother of Imam Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) and the cracking wall?
ai.summary: This report recounts a remarkable event involving the mother of Imam Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام), portraying her spiritual rank and truthfulness. It also preserves Imam al-Ṣādiq’s (عليه السلام) praise for his grandmother, presenting her as an unmatched woman among the descendants of al-Ḥasan. The narration further mentions charity given on her behalf after the event.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Abdullah Bin Ahmad, from Salih Bin Mazeed, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Abu Al Sabbah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> mother was seated by a wall, and the wall cracked, and we heard intense thuds (noise of the cracking). So, she<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘No, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and right of Al-Mustafa<sup>saww</sup>! Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has not Permitted you for the falling!’ So (the wall) remained hanging in the atmosphere until she allowed it (to fall). So my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> gave in charity one hundred Dinars on her<sup>asws</sup> behalf’.

Abu Al-Sabbah said, ‘And Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> mentioned his<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> grandmother<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, the mother of his<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> father, and he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘She<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> was truthful. No woman has been come across in the progeny of Al-Hassan<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, the like of her’. 
Muhammad Bin Al-Hassan, from Abdullah Bin Ahmad – similar to it.
en.sarwar: Abu Ja‘far (a.s.) was born in the year seventy five AH. He passed away in the year one hundred fourteen at the age of fifty seven. He was buried in al-Baqi’ cemetery in Madina near the gave of his father, Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.).
His mother was ’Umm ‘Abdallah daughter of al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn abu Talib, may Allah grant him and his rightly guided offspring blessings.
